title: Canvas Document (schema 2.0)
description: Serialized wenz_draw infinite-canvas document. Forward- and backward-compatible: unknown top-level keys are preserved in CanvasDocument.extras, and elements whose type is unrecognized are preserved as UnknownElement (raw JSON verbatim).

schemaVersion.description: Document schema version. Current is '2.0'. Older documents (1.0/1.1 via a legacy 'version' key) are migrated on load.

version.description: Legacy version key (1.x). Consumed by DocumentMigrator and renamed to schemaVersion; not emitted by current writers.

assets.description: Binary assets referenced out-of-line from elements (images, ...). Keeps documents small when the raster lives on a CDN/filesystem.

custom.description: Free-form extension bag for application-specific metadata.

viewport.description: Last-known view so a reopened board lands where the user left it.

source.description: How 'ref' is resolved: 'base64', 'url', 'file', or a custom kind matched by a host ImageLoader.

element.description: A canvas element. The discriminator is 'type'. Elements with an unrecognized type are preserved verbatim as UnknownElement, so this schema is intentionally permissive (additionalProperties: true).

type.description: Element discriminator. Known types: path, curve, line, polyline, rect, ellipse, drawioShape, arrow, text, image, widget, unknown.

id.description: Stable element id. Should be non-empty; a missing id is flagged by validateForSave.

rect.description: World-space bounding rect (left/top/right/bottom). A rect with right<left or bottom<top is flagged as a warning.
